title: Wizard scope step quick-fill chips are hardcoded examples — make them contextual from recent engagements
goal: The wizard step 2 target input shows three hardcoded quick-fill chips: 'https://app.example.com', 'portal.example.com', 'https://staging.example.com'. These are always the same example URLs regardless of the operator's previous missions. Replace with contextual chips sourced from: (1) the last 2-3 targets from recent completed engagements for the same tile type, pulled from the existing recent-missions cache (RECENT_MISSION_SCOPE_CACHE in wizard.js). (2) Fall back to the current hardcoded examples only when no recent engagement data is available. The '+ Add URL' chip for multi-URL scenarios should remain. This makes the quick-fill chips genuinely useful for repeated assessments against the same targets.
scope: Live audit 2026-05-01: screenshot external-web-s2-target-step.png shows three hardcoded example chips (https://app.example.com, portal.example.com, https://staging.example.com) that are always identical regardless of operator history.
